verdict.rationale: Raygun is a SaaS product with AI features (AI Error Resolution powered by OpenAI and Azure OpenAI), so a training opt-out is a fair question to ask of it. However, the evidence contains no statement or setting that prevents customer data from being used to train AI models. The nearest items are adjacent controls that earn no credit here: client-side filtering of sensitive data, disabling IP address storage, and supplying your own OpenAI API key.
